summary: InMed Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its merger agreement to acquire Mentari Therapeutics. The amendment clarifies the merger sequencing, including a name change to Mentari Therapeutics, redomestication from British Columbia to Nevada, and a potential Nasdaq reverse split. It introduces a PIPE amendment for additional pre-closing financing, affecting the exchange ratio, and confirms tax treatment as a Section 368(a) reorganization. No financial terms or premium were disclosed. The transaction, previously reported, involves a reverse merger structure. Watch for regulatory approval and PIPE financing details; risk lies in shareholder approval and post-merger dilution.
